correctness.rationale: For every frequency H, expand each Boolean character as a product of (1-2x_e), retain linear terms modulo four, and count partitions with any specified pair co-block by a chord-splitting and adjacent-endpoint contraction bijection, yielding C_d C_(n-d). Catalan 2-adic valuations and parity of critical graph coordinates prove all claimed cases with exact quantifiers. The package checker exhaustively verifies 2,131,018 frequencies through n=7 and checks n<=10 directly/sampled. The infinite proof does not depend on sampling.

originality.rationale: After checking the accessible own ledger, repeated semantic published-finding corpus searches, full texts of Nica–Speicher and Deutsch–Sagan, and the Simion survey, no prior theorem identified computes all graph-character residues modulo four for the Boolean co-block incidence image of NC partitions. The strongest close title concerns a different incidence-algebra Fourier transform. The result is an explicit new implication not provided by enumeration parity alone, subject to bounded priority coverage. The prior polygon-triangulation result is acknowledged as a close methodological analog but concerns different incidence coordinates and does not imply the exact even-order critical-chord stratum.
residual_risks: A preexisting character-weighted noncrossing partition polynomial may implicitly contain the same modulo-four specialization.
Semantic search and selected primary-source inspection do not establish historical uniqueness.
Only congruence-based rank claims are made; no unsupplied complete zero-set classification is assumed.

The modulo-four proof is methodologically close to a prior polygon-triangulation Catalan Fourier congruence; its mathematical contribution rests on the new co-block event identity and even-order classification, not the generic first-order expansion.

value.rationale: The all-graph-frequency congruence is an exact structural invariant for a canonical Catalan family. It proves infinitely many even-cardinality supports give invertible Boolean convolution, with every eigenvalue having precise 2-adic valuation, and gives an exact half of valuation-one modes for a separate infinite even-order family. Ordinary Catalan cardinality parity does not imply these Fourier consequences. A previous polygon-triangulation result uses a similar modulo-four idea; novelty and value here rely on the distinct planar co-block event count and the all-order critical-chord/half-spectrum arithmetic, not merely method repetition.
